scope: Personal-test player motion, artwork gestures and seeking

regressions.before: 16 engine seek assignments in one drag
regressions.after: zero during drag, one on release

regressions.before: Browser image drag prevents next-track selection
regressions.after: Both viewport cases pass with source image dragging disabled

regressions.before: Fetch response disposed while route handler was completing
regressions.after: Wait for active route handlers; complete 66-case rerun passed

review.correctness: Entry identity and play/pause intent retained; stale artwork/seek callbacks guarded; cancellation and boundaries covered
review.readability: Separate surface/artwork/seek owners; no dependency added or test assertion disabled
review.architecture: UI-thread native interaction; existing provider and audio engine remain owners of playback
review.security: No new media access or credential persistence; server playback authorization remains required
review.performance: Native drag/progress use shared values and transforms; no per-frame React state or engine seeks
review.limitations: Physical iPhone/Redmi smoothness, rotation, accessibility and interruption acceptance remain open
